full_judgment: 2. Short facts as placed before the High Court Division are that 6.37 acres of land recorded in S.A. Plot No. 126 under District Settlement Khatian No. 53/1 of Monza Kalahari within Dumuria police Station in the District of Khulna belonged to two brothers namely Ismail Khan and Moslem Khan, that Ismail Khan died leaving behind his only brother Moslem Khan as his heir and I successor. Thereafter Moslem Khan died leaving behind two sons Mujibor Khan and accused Rustam Ali Khan who inherited the aforesaid property in equal shares, that Mujibor Khan transferred one acre of land out of said property on 20.02.1994 to complainant P.W.1 Abdul Karim Moral vide Deed No. 1181 and on the same date he also transferred 0.5 acres of land vide sale Deed No. 1186 to the P.W. 6 Abdul Hamid and Nurul Islam Golder. Thereafter Mujibor Khan again transferred 1.68 acres of land out of the said property on 02.04.1995 vide registered sale Deed No. 2564 to the complainant and his brother Abdul Mannan Moral. The complainant and his brother got their names mutated on 20.09.1994 vide Mutation Case No. 196 of 1992-93 in respect of 1.5 acres of land and are in possession of their purchased land. Accused Rustam Ali Khan fabricated a deed of gift dated 11.10.1971 bearing No. 1249 purported to be executed by his father Moslem Khan in his favour in respect of entire 6.37 acres of land of the aforesaid khatian and filed an application before the assistant Commissioner (Land) Dumuria under section 150 of the State Acquisition and Tenancy Act being Miscellaneous Case No. 24 of 1996-97 but the said case was disallowed on the ground that the so called deed of gift was a forged document.
